input.command:
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
python -c "
import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
c = load('examples/service.conf'); print(c.__dict__)
d = 'tmpt'; os.makedirs(d + '/sub')
w = lambda n, s: open(d + '/' + n, 'w').write(s)
w('a.conf', '@include b.conf\n'); w('b.conf', '@include a.conf\n')
w('m.conf', '@include nope\n'); w('s.conf', 'x = 1\n@include sub/i.conf\nz = 9\n')
w('sub/i.conf', 'x = 2\ny = 3\n@include j.conf\n'); w('sub/j.conf', 'y = 4\n')
for f in 'am':
    try: load(d + '/' + f + '.conf')
    except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
print(load(d + '/s.conf').__dict__)
"; rm -rf tmpt
